summary: State-sliced CSVs of US dental practices and dentists extracted from the CMS NPPES weekly public download. The full national dataset has 279,000+ licensed dentists; each record includes practice name, address, phone, NPI number, specialty taxonomy (general dentist, orthodontist, oral surgeon, periodontist, etc.), and credential type. USADoctorList.com charges $97 per state for the same NPPES-derived data; BizProspex charges $340 for a dental email list; an entire domain (DentistDatabases.com) exists for this market. A one-time state-specific file at $29–$39 targets the dental SaaS vendor, supply rep, and lab supplier audience that is actively buying these lists.

audience.who: Dental SaaS vendors (practice management software like Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Curve Dental, Carestream) whose SDRs need a current list of practices to cold-call; dental supply and equipment reps; dental lab and imaging companies; dental staffing agencies; dental continuing education providers targeting dentists in specific metro areas.

data_wanted: Practice/business name, individual dentist name, NPI number, address (street, city, state, ZIP), phone number, fax (where available), specialty taxonomy code (e.g., 1223G0001X = General Practice, 1223X0400X = Orthodontics), credential type — all sourced from the CMS NPPES weekly downloadable file (npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov), no login or API key required.

evidence.source: CMS NPPES — weekly public download of all NPI holders, including all licensed dentists and dental practices, no authentication required
evidence.quote: NPI data is downloadable from CMS, with the downloadable database being updated weekly.

evidence.source: USADoctorList.com — charges $97 per state for NPPES-derived dentist CSV (March 2026 NPPES release), proving buyer willingness to pay for formatted state slices of the same public data
evidence.quote: Individual state lists can be purchased for $97. The complete US dentists database contains 279,464 licensed dental professionals across all 50 states, sourced from the March 2026 NPPES release.

evidence.source: BizProspex — charges $340 for dental email list, proving premium market for dental professional contact data
DentistDatabases.com — an entire commercial site dedicated to selling dental practice contact lists, confirming mature, sustained B2B demand
evidence.quote: Buy Verified Dentist Email List | Targeted Email Marketing

willingness_to_pay.signal: USADoctorList.com charges $97/state; BizProspex charges $340 for a dental email list; DentistDatabases.com is an entire business built on this vertical. A $29–$39 state-slice CSV is 60–70% cheaper than the nearest direct competitor (USADoctorList) while targeting the same dental SaaS SDR who needs to reach 3,000–8,000 dentists in a specific state for a campaign.

first_sale_path.channel: Gumroad listing + Reddit r/dental, r/dentistry, r/SaaS, LinkedIn targeting dental SaaS SDRs and dental supply reps
first_sale_path.angle: "Texas Dentists & Dental Practices — 2026 Database, 17,000+ Records, CSV" — NPI, specialty, address, phone, ready to import. Positioned against $97/state incumbents: 'Same NPPES data. $39. No subscription. Download now.' Launch with the two highest-population states (TX and FL) as separate SKUs to test price sensitivity.
